title: libumqtt is vulnerable to an integer underflow which may allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service, memory…
description: libumqtt contains an integer underflow vulnerability that could be exploited by a remote attacker to cause denial of service, memory corruption, or information disclosure. The vulnerability is identified as CWE-191 and has a high severity score of 8.6. No specific affected versions or patches are currently provided.
